rules.description: All parameters and return type must be explicitly typed
Function must be deterministic — no Math.random, Date.now, or external state
No DOM, network, storage, timer, or console calls
No React, Next.js, or browser-specific imports — must run in Node and browser
Must not mutate input arguments — return new values
Every branch and line must be covered by tests
JSDoc comment with @param and @returns annotations required
Function must be a named export — no default-only exports
